current_title: MECH-353 blocked-agency (z_block) discriminative diagnostic. Static landmark env (z_world tracks position; harm + goal-value held constant) repeatedly blocks an intended predicted-to-succeed action. ARM_BLOCK vs ARM_CONTROL, same trained agent. Per seed: P0 trains E2.world_forward on the one-hot discrete executed action so the SD-029 action-outcome comparator discriminates; P1a scripted-driver readout of z_block / outcome_mismatch / z_harm_a; P1b policy-driver readout of assert-vs-withdraw behaviour. Measures (a) z_block rises under block, (b) drives assert/persist distinct from withdraw, (c) DISSOCIATES from z_harm_a (zero noxious input). 2 conditions x 3 seeds. Diagnostic, claim_ids=[].
